0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Grawley needs estimates and he needs them now.

24.original: Request supply estimates from the villagers.

48.original: Listen, friend, I'm run off my feet here. I need someone to take stock of our remaining food stores, and you just volunteered.

50.original: Nigh everything this village needs to survive is hauled up from the lowlands, and if matters don't settle down soon... Well, I won't be surprised when Wright and Stilltide begin hoarding goods instead of selling 'em. Not unless it's for an outrageous price.

51.original: Anyway, that's enough speculation. I need estimates─accurate estimates, mind you─from them what's in charge of our edibles. Grains, grog, and meats. Off you hop.

52.original: Grains, grog, and meats. Speak to the villagers and find out what we've got left...

53.original: Grawley wants an estimate? Well you can tell him, “Not bloody much.” We'll need to think of something 'cause we're runnin' low on both grain <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> beans...

54.original: Grawley wants an estimate? Well you can tell him, “Not bloody much.” We'll need to think of something 'cause we're runnin' low on both grain <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> beans...

55.original: <sigh> We've put a good dent in the liquor we got from the dwarves, so we might have to make do with water at some point. At least we've a fresh source with the river nearby.

57.original: <sigh> We've put a good dent in the liquor we got from the dwarves, so we might have to make do with water at some point. At least we've a fresh source with the river nearby.

58.original: Hmmm. I'd say we have more than enough dried meat to go around. There was peril in the hunt, but the haul was plentiful.

59.original: Hmmm. I'd say we have more than enough dried meat to go around. There was peril in the hunt, but the haul was plentiful.

61.original: ...Grain is a problem, then. I'll see if we can't trade our surplus meat in Wright for a few sacks of barley and the like.

62.original: That will get us through for the moment, but we'll need to come up with a long-term plan...

64.original: ...Well, I'll think of something. Thanks for doing the legwork, friend! Say, have you ever considered taking up work as a quartermaster...?
